create.name: Loch Kelly
create.bio:
Loch Kelly is an American meditation teacher and author whose approach, which he calls Effortless Mindfulness, draws on the Mahamudra and Dzogchen teachings of Tibetan Buddhism. After graduate study in theology and social work in New York, a travelling fellowship took him to Sri Lanka, India and Nepal, where he learned from several Buddhist masters, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche among them. For about two decades he also worked as a psychotherapist in New York community clinics, and he later founded a non-profit, the Effortless Mindfulness Institute, to carry the teaching forward.

His method centres on short practices he calls glimpses, which invite students to notice the open awareness that is already present rather than to concentrate harder, and then to bring that shift into ordinary activity. He sets this out in two books from Sounds True, Shift into Freedom and The Way of Effortless Mindfulness, and in the Mindful Glimpses app of brief guided meditations. He teaches through recorded Level One and Level Two trainings, conversations and guided practices on his YouTube channel, and weekend programmes at Kripalu with the IFS therapist Paige Kelly, where in recent years he has paired the meditation with the parts-based model of Internal Family Systems.

books.title: The Way of Effortless Mindfulness: A Revolutionary Guide for Living an Awakened Life
books.author: Loch Kelly
books.description: A practical handbook of Loch's glimpse practices, arranged as a sequence of short exercises with commentary. It moves from noticing awareness itself to resting in it while thinking, feeling and relating to others.

books.title: Shift into Freedom: The Science and Practice of Open-Hearted Awareness
books.author: Loch Kelly
books.description: His first book, which lays out the idea of moving from a thought-centred sense of self to open, heart-centred awareness. Guided practices sit alongside his account of the Tibetan teachings behind them and some of the research on attention.

courses.title: Effortless Mindfulness Level One Training
courses.description: A self-paced online course of six video modules that introduces the map and method of Effortless Mindfulness. It comes with guided glimpse recordings, worksheets, transcripts and reading.

courses.title: Effortless Mindfulness Level Two Program
courses.description: The follow-on to Level One, open to those who have finished it, with 87 recorded lessons, glimpse audio practices and written material. Two self-guided retreats open and close the programme.

courses.title: Mindful Glimpses app
courses.description: A phone app of guided micro-meditations by Loch, from one to twenty minutes long, built around his glimpse practices. It is free to download, with a subscription for the full library after a two-week trial.
courses.price: $9.99 USD per month or $69.99 USD per year

free_resources.title: Four-Minute Effortless Mindfulness Meditation
free_resources.description: A short animated practice on Kripalu's site in which Loch guides the listener to notice the gap between thoughts. It is a quick first taste of his approach.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @LochKelly 18.6K subscribers (channel header, 1 Nov 2026); his own site (lochkelly.org), which would list his social accounts, returns a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl and WebFetch, so no Instagram, Facebook, X or TikTok accounts could be confirmed as his (an Instagram @lochkelly with 255 followers exists but nothing links it to him) → ~18.6k total → local_hero
flags: His website lochkelly.org (and mindfulglimpses.com, which redirects to it) sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge and could not be read; the Internet Archive was offline. Bio sources are Kripalu, his YouTube channel, Tricycle and other public pages instead of his own home and about pages.
Email contact@lochkelly.org is published on his own ThriveCart course checkout pages (as the address for refund requests), not on a contact page; it is his domain, but may be a support inbox.

His only Kripalu programme, 'Waking Up and Healing Up: Experiencing Effortless Mindfulness and IFS' (23-25 Apr 2027, $350 tuition plus lodging), is left out as an offering: it is co-led with IFS psychotherapist Paige Kelly and framed around IFS healing of 'hurt parts', inner critics and burnout. Borderline under the psychotherapy and health rules; the owner may want to add it back. He stays linked to Kripalu as current faculty.

He describes himself as an IFS psychotherapist and some recent YouTube videos pair the meditation with IFS or name anxiety; those were left out, but his main body of work (books, trainings, app, most of the channel) is nondual meditation, so he is not skipped under the therapy rule.

He is listed in docs/content-audits/the-shift-network-faculty.json (Effortless Mindfulness, activity 'older'); his Shift Network teacher page returned 403 and no current course was confirmed, so the-shift-network is not added to teaches_at.
Tier: only YouTube could be counted; as an author of two Sounds True books with a widely used app the owner may consider an editorial-stature override, which I have not applied.
Availability set to worldwide: I could not confirm a physical base where he sees people or holds classes.
Paige Kelly co-presents his Kripalu programme and shares his surname; I could not confirm their relationship, so the bio names her only as a co-teacher. She is not a separate listing.
left_out: Kripalu programme 'Waking Up and Healing Up: Experiencing Effortless Mindfulness and IFS' (23-25 Apr 2027): borderline psychotherapy/health framing (see flags).

YouTube: 'Guided Meditation to Relieve Anxiety at the Root', 'From Anxiety to Awake Loving Flow', '5 Levels of Mind Explained | Navigate Anxiety & Parts...', 'Addressing Attention Overload Disorder' (condition-named); 'IFS and Effortless Mindfulness (EM+IFS): Support for Waking Up and Healing Up' and other IFS-led videos (psychotherapy); 'Experiencing Emotional Liberation' (borderline therapeutic framing); 'Living From Awakening: Adyashanti Part I' (Adyashanti is the main speaker); Shorts, student testimonials and clips under 2 minutes; app promo.
Effortless Mindfulness Level One + Level Two bundle and the live virtual group training tier: covered by the two single-level offerings.
Shift Network 'Effortless Mindfulness' course: no current listing confirmed (page 403).
Anything else on lochkelly.org (retreat calendar, free resources, contact form): site unreadable behind a bot challenge.
